items.name: Shepherd's Crook-Pin
items.lore: A little silver crook. Kerra's mother wore it, and her mother.

items.name: White Fang Necklace
items.lore: A long white canine on a leather thong. It was hard won.

items.name: Moor-Grass Cloak
items.lore: Woven of Cornish wool and dyed the colour of the moor in autumn.

items.name: Stalker-Bone Ring
items.lore: Carved from a death stalker's bone. Cold to wear.

items.name: Eagle of the Ninth
items.lore: A legion's bronze eagle, small enough now to wear. It was carried into the marsh four hundred years ago.

items.name: Kit's Heather Wreath
items.lore: A wreath of dried heather, bound with red thread. It does not crumble.

items.name: Legionary Cingulum
items.lore: A soldier's belt of bronze plates. The leather is new; the bronze is very old.

items.name: Standard-Bearer's Cape
items.lore: A wolfskin cape, of the kind a legion's standard-bearer wore over his helm.

items.name: Moor-Walker's Ring
items.lore: Plain bronze. Every new face at the Station gets one.

items.name: Heather Sash
items.lore: Woven heather, dyed purple.

items.name: Spider-Silk Wristwrap
items.lore: Cliff-spider silk. Sticky, then not.

items.name: Cliff-Edge Charm
items.lore: A sea-polished pebble from the cliff foot.

items.name: Penhale's Spare Bracer
items.lore: Dented, polished, reliable.

items.name: Station Watchman's Belt
items.lore: The Men of Tintagel's own belt.

items.name: Moor-Wolf Fang
items.lore: Your first proper trophy in Cornwall.

items.name: Cliff-Spider Fang Ring
items.lore: Hollow, venom long dried.

items.name: Web-Cloak
items.lore: Grey silk over wool. It sheds rain.

items.name: Gorlois's Boar Ring
items.lore: The boar of Cornwall, Gorlois's sign.

items.name: Ghostly Church Bell-Clapper Charm
items.lore: It rings, very faintly, at midnight.

items.name: Duke's Man Mantle
items.lore: Cornish black and gold.

items.name: Muryan's Thimble Ring
items.lore: A thimble, very small. The muryan who wore it was smaller.

items.name: Tricker's Patchwork Sash
items.lore: A hundred stolen scraps.

items.name: Bucca's Fish-Bone Charm
items.lore: The buccas leave fish-bones for luck. This one didn't work for them.

items.name: Storm-Bucca's Bracer
items.lore: Wet, always, as though from the sea.

items.name: Den Mother's Pelt
items.lore: Grey, huge, thick enough to sleep in the snow.

items.name: Pack-Leader Tooth Torc
items.lore: Three yellow teeth on a torc.

items.name: Beech-Heart Ring
items.lore: Smooth beech-heart, warm to the touch.

items.name: Old Beech Mantle
items.lore: Bark-brown, lined with beech-leaf green.

items.name: Rooter-Tusk Bracer
items.lore: Ivory, cracked, bound in bronze.

items.name: Downs-Digger's Belt
items.lore: Thick leather. It smells of turned earth.

items.name: Legionary's Bronze Phalera
items.lore: A bronze medal, green with age. For valour.

items.name: Marching-Road Bracer
items.lore: Iron and leather, Roman-made.

items.name: Giant-Rune Shard
items.lore: A shard of rune-stone, cracked across the middle.

items.name: Favius's Vine-Staff Ring
items.lore: From a centurion's vine-staff. He used it on his men, not his enemies.

items.name: Old Fort Mantle
items.lore: Roman red, faded nearly pink.

items.name: Aquila Feather
items.lore: A gilt feather from the eagle of the Ninth. It's warm.

items.name: Legate's Signet
items.lore: Gold and carnelian, the legion's number cut in it.

items.name: Ninth's Rest Mantle
items.lore: Roman red, with a white eagle. Given to whoever brought the Ninth home.

items.name: Giant-Grave Torc
items.lore: Huge, cut down, still too heavy.

items.name: Captured-Soul Lantern Charm
items.lore: A lantern-glass. Something grateful lived in it once.

items.name: Quarry-Giant's Chisel Ring
items.lore: A chisel-tip, bent round. It cut granite once.

items.name: Stoneshaper's Belt
items.lore: Granite plates on leather.

items.name: Corinean Oath-Torc
items.lore: Iron and gold, the oath-keepers' sign.

items.name: Cirfans' Scale
items.lore: A drake-scale the size of a buckler, cut down to a charm.

items.name: Heir of Corineus Mantle
items.lore: Cornish black, with Corineus's wrestling-belt in gold.

items.name: Drake-Fire Ring
items.lore: Red-gold. It never cools.

items.name: Great Drake's Tooth
items.lore: As long as your forearm.
